value.rationale: Q3 is the canonical smallest 3D hypercube interconnection network; an exact full finite metric and sharp worst-case routing budget are motivated invariants, not an arbitrary parameter slice. The unique antipode and 24-case sharp deficit of 3 beyond the standard token-home distance lower bound distinguish optimal sequencing from transport costs and provide a precise benchmark. The exact claim need not assert a new all-dimensional algorithm, and no such extrapolation is claimed.
